records.narr_swing_public: whether the 2026 organic re-acceleration (company organic growth near 6% in Q2 and Q3 against roughly 2% a year earlier, R&DS organic near 7%) carries into 2027 as the rising LTM net new bookings convert, or fades back toward the low-single-digit organic rate of 2023-2025 once the easy comps, the M&A contribution (now 200-250 bp of FY2026 growth) and the post-trough rebound in biotech funding are lapped; the first read is the 2027 framework at the December 1 investor day and the FY2027 guide with the Q4 print in February 2027.
